name: directive-above-another-comment
description: A directive binds only the declaration that begins on the next line, or on its own line when it trails code there, and a declaration begins on the line of its first token, a decorator included. A directive above a marker comment that sits directly above a constant binds nothing and is stale, and the constant stays reported. A directive above a class's decorator binds the class, and so does one trailing the decorator, while a directive between the decorator and the class keyword binds nothing and is stale beside the class's finding.
